title: EnrichmentClaimHologram
description: A claim hologram produced by an Enrichment Twin. Extends the canonical ProCybernetica claim pattern with enrichment-specific fields: asset binding, sensitivity class, modality, confidence, and a provenance root that records analyzer, model, locus, and scheduling rationale. Every output is a governed claim — never a raw fact. See docs/architecture/enrichment-twin-mission-spec.md §4.

archetypes.description: Ontology archetypes this hologram participates in. Must include 'Claim'; typically also 'EvidenceBearingObject'.

confidence.description: Model confidence score [0,1]. Required for all non-structural claims.

modality.description: Analysis modality that produced this claim

sensitivity_class.description: Sensitivity class governing eligible placement loci. If absent, treated as 'sensitive'.

superseded_by.description: If non-null, this claim has been superseded by the referenced hologram id. Retained for provenance; hidden from default projection.

supersedes.description: If non-null, this claim supersedes the referenced hologram id.

relations.description: Must include at least derived_from (asset), produced_by (twin), governed_by (policy)

policy_envelope.description: Policy ref governing this claim's access and projection

provenance_root.description: Primary provenance ref. The referenced provenance_record must include: analyzer_id, analyzer_version, model_id, model_version, asset_hash, execution_locus, scheduled_because, sensitivity_class.
